I don't have their authorization handy right now. Could you tell me what the process is for them to arrange an appointment? Do they need to call themselves?

An adult patient can call us directly to arrange their own appointment. If you want to schedule for them, you'll just need to confirm you're authorized to do so when you call. Either option works, whatever is easier for you and your family member.
Thanks for explaining. So the adult family member should call themselves to arrange the visit if they want to be sure everything goes smoothly, right?
If your family member calls themselves, the process is usually quicker and smoother. If you call for them, just be ready to confirm you're authorized to help with their care.
